name: chromodynamic
description: CHROMODYNAMIC - cross-platform, cross-API hybrid 2D+3D engine + framework
$x-policy-note: vcpkg dependencies are ONLY listed here when an engine target actually calls
find_package(<name>) for them. The graphics stack (vulkan-headers, volk, VMA,
glslang, shaderc, glfw, glm, spdlog, ktx, meshoptimizer, basis-universal,
fastgltf, miniaudio, jolt-physics, etc.) is intentionally pulled via
FetchContent in each consuming subdirectory's CMakeLists.txt - this lets us
pin EXACT SDK / commit versions per-subsystem instead of inheriting whatever
vcpkg baseline shipped that week. See docs/BUILDING.md section 'Dependency
Resolution Tiers' for the full policy.
Promote a dep into this manifest only when you have ALSO wired
find_package(<name> CONFIG) into the consuming CMakeLists.txt and tested it
resolves from vcpkg.
FetchContent-only deps (NOT in vcpkg registry — intentionally absent here):
bc7enc_rdo (richgel999/bc7enc_rdo, MIT) — BC7 block encoder for
cd::asset::texture_compress Sprint-2 (phase750). No vcpkg port exists;
no CMake library target in upstream; consumed via FetchContent_Populate +
manual add_library(bc7enc_rdo_lib) from bc7enc.cpp only. Guarded by
CD_TC_HAS_BC7ENC compile definition. Target: bc7enc_rdo_lib (PRIVATE).
astc-encoder 4.7.0 (ARM-software/astc-encoder, Apache-2.0) — ASTC 4x4/8x8
block encoder for cd::asset::texture_compress Sprint-2 (phase750). No vcpkg
port exists; consumed via FetchContent_MakeAvailable with ASTCENC_ISA_NONE=ON
(portable, no SIMD). CMake target: astcenc-none-static (PRIVATE). Guarded by
CD_TC_HAS_ASTCENC compile definition.

dependencies.name: gtest
dependencies.$comment: Unit testing - ADR-014 + ADR-005. Resolved via find_package(GTest CONFIG) in top-level CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent + vendored fallback tiers.

dependencies.name: fmt
dependencies.$comment: Logging format - ADR-005 section B + ADR-017 P1. Resolved via find_package(fmt CONFIG QUIET) in top-level CMakeLists.txt; optional Phase 1.

dependencies.name: spirv-cross
dependencies.$comment: GLSL/SPIR-V → HLSL/MSL/GLSL cross-compilation for cd_spirv_cross_glue (B-infra1). Promote a dep only when find_package is wired. Resolved via find_package(spirv_cross_core CONFIG) in engine/render/spirv_cross_glue/CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent fallback (vulkan-sdk-1.3.268.0).

dependencies.name: freetype
dependencies.$comment: TTF/OTF outline rasterizer for cd_ui_font Phase 4 (ADR-20260530 + ADR-009). Resolved via find_package(Freetype CONFIG) in engine/ui/font/CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent fallback (VER-2-13-3). When unavailable, the stb_truetype backend (sibling CD_UI_FONT_BACKEND=stb) continues to compile and pass its tests. version>= uses 2.13.2 (minimum that exists in the version DB; 2.13.0 has no DB entry).

dependencies.name: harfbuzz
dependencies.$comment: OpenType shaping engine (BiDi / ligature / Indic conjunct) for cd_ui_font Phase 4. The 'freetype' feature provides hb-ft.h used by HarfBuzzShaping.cpp + FreeTypeBackend.cpp. Resolved via find_package(harfbuzz CONFIG) in engine/ui/font/CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent fallback.

dependencies.name: lz4
dependencies.$comment: Lossless compression codec for cd::game::save_compression Sprint-2 (Phase 749). compress_lz4() / decompress_lz4() added beside the RLE path; RLE kept for back-compat. Resolved via find_package(lz4 CONFIG QUIET) in engine/game/save_compression/CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent fallback (tag v1.10.0). Target: lz4::lz4. Moment: 5 MB save -> ~600 KB at ~100 MB/s.

dependencies.name: joltphysics
dependencies.$comment: Jolt Physics 5.x — MIT, AAA-shipping multicore rigid-body solver (ADR-008 + ADR-20260530). Promoted from phase2-physics feature gate to active top-level dependency in FINALE-3/W2B-C2 (phase748). Resolved via find_package(Jolt CONFIG) in engine/world/physics_jolt/CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent fallback (tag v5.5.0). CMake target: Jolt::Jolt. Enables cd::physics_jolt real JPH::PhysicsSystem backend replacing the semi-implicit Euler stub.

dependencies.name: openal-soft
dependencies.$comment: OpenAL Soft — LGPL cross-platform HRTF convolution audio backend for cd::audio::spatial Sprint-2 (phase751). Provides real HRTF convolution via OpenAL's built-in HRTF dataset (44100/48000 Hz binaural rendering). Resolved via find_package(OpenAL CONFIG QUIET) in engine/world/audio_spatial/CMakeLists.txt with FetchContent fallback (tag 1.24.2). CMake target: OpenAL::OpenAL. When unavailable CD_AUDIO_SPATIAL_HAS_OPENAL=0 and HrtfMixer falls back to ITD/ILD path (Sprint-1 SpatialMixer). Moment: 3D audio sounds like Half-Life Alyx (proper HRTF, not pan).

dependencies.name: msdfgen
dependencies.$comment: Multi-channel signed distance field generator for cd::ui::font AtlasMode::kMsdfMulti (phase752 Sprint-2). Core-only build (no extensions/skia/libpng/tinyxml2) — we supply glyph outlines via our existing FreeType integration and only use msdfgen's generateMSDF() on Shape objects. Resolved via find_package(msdfgen CONFIG) in engine/ui/font/CMakeLists.txt. CMake targets: msdfgen::msdfgen-core. When unavailable, kMsdfMulti degrades to kMsdf (8-SSED Euclidean approximation). Moment: sharp glyph corners (no rounding artifacts), MSDF text scales 8x without blurring.

phase2-render.description: Phase 2 RHI Vulkan dependencies. Reserved - currently FetchContent-resolved in engine/render/rhi_vulkan/CMakeLists.txt. Promote here once find_package wiring lands.

phase2-asset.description: Phase 2 asset pipeline (ktx, fastgltf, meshoptimizer, basis-universal). Reserved.

phase2-audio.description: Phase 2 audio backend extras (miniaudio cross-platform fallback). Reserved.

phase2-physics.description: Phase 2 physics backend gate — now superseded: joltphysics promoted to top-level `dependencies` in FINALE-3/W2B-C2 (phase748). This feature gate kept as a tombstone so no existing cmake -Dfeature= invocations break; it carries no additional deps.

webgpu.description: WebGPU backend for cd::ui_renderer_webgpu via google/dawn (phase522). Opt-in: heavy dep (~800 MB). Also set -DCD_ENABLE_WEBGPU=ON at configure time.

dependencies.name: dawn
dependencies.$comment: google/dawn — open-source cross-platform WebGPU implementation (BSD-3-Clause). Port available in vcpkg baseline 56bb2411. Requires Abseil + Python host tooling. Version pinned to 20251202.213730 by the baseline; bump baseline to get a newer snapshot.

$x-baseline-comment: vcpkg commit f14401ca (2026-01-24 local tool HEAD). Provides freetype 2.13.3 + harfbuzz 12.3.1 + spirv-cross 1.4.328.0. Previous baseline 56bb2411 (2026.04.27) targeted freetype 2.14.3 + harfbuzz 14.2.0 which are absent from the local version DB — caused vcpkg manifest-install failure. Bump when vcpkg tool is updated past this commit.
